qemu_only_limitations: QEMU standard VGA GOP stands in for the TG01 RTX 3060 firmware GOP. The hardware kernel has no native driver for this adapter (CONFIG_DRM_BOCHS unset, no virtio GPU present), so the display ran through simpledrm on the EFI framebuffer; physical RTX 3060 behavior is unproven
virtio-blk stands in for the owner's USB SSD; this image's boot from emulated USB storage is recorded by the usb variant of this acceptance
USB keyboard/tablet are QEMU devices; TG01 HID behavior is unproven
desktop_proof: ab peel: each full-stack window is closed by its own proven primitive (browser by focus click + Ctrl+Shift+W, files and update GUI by their drawn close boxes, first window by raise + Escape) and the terminal is focused and exited by the typed fixed exit command; success is the login screen's return, the session's own end condition. No drag/resize is claimed for the A/B desktop.
